_note: MA-2c: where a set_parameter's value may come from. kind_pset (review C19) is the add-in's PropertyPlanner.KindPset and the bridge's KIND_PSET; catalog_param and kind_entity are the add-in's PropertyPlanner.CatalogParam and PromoteWallsPlanner.Classes (upper-cased) and the bridge's CATALOG_PARAM and KIND_ENTITY; catalog is a type_catalog@n body (BDS rows, Fire Rating filled on two); ids is an ids@n body whose clauses the cases read. class_noun (review C23) is the noun a whole-class sentence names each entity by: the bridge's CLASS_NOUN and the add-in's Clauses.ClassNoun. value_cases (review C23) are single clauses, judged by the bridge's notAValue and the add-in's Clauses.NotAValue for entity and key (IFCDOOR and Pset_DoorCommon.FireRating when not given): why null = cited; compiled = the sentence compiles (compileIds) to exactly that value, entity and key. document_cases (review C23 context) are documents compileIds compiles (specifications, held to compileIds by vitest) and the values both sides cite from them: a sentence is cited only when its document said nothing but whole-class one-value sentences (source_alone). catalog_trim (review C23): a catalogue value is trimmed of ASCII blanks only on both sides (GuidelineMatcher.CatalogValue, makeCiter). tools/promote-check and vitest read this file.
